hypothesis: 点时可见的未平仓量变化、USD-M 主动买卖比和大小账户仓位分歧，可能在现有价格动量与波动基线之外改善 BTC 四小时有序收益分布。

sample_contract.information_cutoff: latest metric and closed spot bar at or before the decision hour
sample_contract.outcome: BTCUSDT spot close return over the following four hours
sample_contract.split: chronological 60/20/20 with a four-hour purge before each boundary
sample_contract.probability_estimator: empirical ordered cells with Dirichlet smoothing 20

baseline: development-frozen momentum_4h tercile by realized_volatility_4h median

validation_gate.primary: candidate ordinal ranked probability score must beat the baseline in every independent phase
validation_gate.continuous: mean absolute return error must not worsen and expected-versus-realized return correlation must be positive and exceed the baseline
validation_gate.economic: top-minus-bottom expected-return quintile realized spread must exceed 15 bps in every independent phase
validation_gate.selection: first candidate in frozen complexity order satisfying every gate

blind_rule: Do not compute the reserved final 20 percent unless validation passes; a blind pass still grants only a new prospective research behavior, never historical capital permission.
